title: A deterministic linear walk clock on tree-weighted planar maps
exact_target: For the spanning-tree-weighted spherical n-edge planar-map ensemble, with degree probability measure and the spatial normalization specified by its metric limit, do the conditional walk path laws on every [0,T], accelerated by exactly n, converge jointly with the metric–measure map to the conditional Liouville Brownian motion law on the sqrt(2)-quantum sphere? The requested clock coefficient is one for the stated generator and continuum Dirichlet-form conventions.
